svg.aria-label: codex-staff: Claude Code (/codex-staff:*) and Pi (/skill:codex-*) delegate work to Codex CLI running as a background worker through codex exec --json. Four persona workers: staffer for general tasks, researcher for evidence-backed research with explicit uncertainty, reviewer for code, plan or decision review, implementer for scoped changes with verification. /codex-staff:lead lets the host agent orchestrate an ongoing task with Codex. Unrestricted by default with a sandbox on request, inherits your Codex model and reasoning settings, resumable threads and persistent jobs.
svg.text: unrestricted by default · sandbox on request
